title: The Postmark From Tomorrow

beats.text: Elias found the first letter on November 15th, 2026, though the postmark was dated a week ahead and he felt the air is heavy.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a vintage envelope on a dark wooden floor, slow zoom, cinematic lighting

beats.text: It was a noise complaint from a neighbor who had been dead for years, describing screams Elias hadn't even uttered yet.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome shot of a dimly lit apartment hallway with deep shadows, slow zoom, fog drifting

beats.text: The air is heavy, he whispered, bolting his door while the monochrome fog swallowed the streetlights outside his lonely window.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a hand slowly locking a door bolt, atmospheric smoke, slow zoom

beats.text: On the 22nd, a final letter arrived, a simple thank-you note for finally vacating the world of the living.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome shot of an empty mailbox inside a dark building, heavy shadows, slow zoom

beats.text: He looked at the date, then at his own transparent hands, realizing he wasn't receiving mail from the future, but from the life he had already lost. This story is a work of fiction.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome shot of a translucent hand reaching into a beam of moonlight, slow zoom, heavy grain

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
